t: You're on Adelaide Street, a short street in Westminster that carries on from Chandos Place, running from William IV Street in the north down to Duncannon Street in the south. Most of it is pedestrianised, with just a small spur at the top that vehicles can use. The name honours Queen Adelaide, who was Queen of the United Kingdom and of Hanover from eighteen thirty to eighteen thirty-seven, as the wife of King William IV. It's a quiet little link between busier streets.
